decisions.reason: The gold-medal premium raisin stollen is the firm's publicly announced flagship, so both its proven success and the firm's visible commitment argue firmly for keeping it.

The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established rye range and uses existing know-how and facilities, and having already dropped one rye bread, management sees no reason to reverse another earlier decision.
The dark barley malt rye remains a niche variant without reported success, but its low incremental cost and shared production let management attribute weak demand to temporary causes and persist.
The marzipan stollen rounds out the committed Christmas stollen line around the flagship, so dropping it would undercut the seasonal gift direction the firm has publicly embraced.
Having publicly presented the ancient grain bread as its newest masterpiece, management feels bound to justify that claim and give the product more time.
